matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled cover, people/non-operative counts, plea and basis state, disputed-fact list, Newton/sentence chronology, source and order map.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 10-14 pages; 300-500 words per narrative page or 10-22 sourced rows/events per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with searchable text, stable source links and controlled repeated headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unresolved Newton issue, late report and draft-order conflict retained in dated versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Child identity, health, PSR and privileged strategy restricted; audience variants receive minimum authorised detail.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied evidence, generic sentencing law, repeated chronology or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Count/indictment record, plea hearing, defence written basis, prosecution response and proposition-by-proposition agreed/disputed schedule.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 15-22 pages; forms at authentic density, bases/responses 300-500 words/page and issue tables 6-16 propositions/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed documents and signed/scanned basis where realistic; hearing record source-linked.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended basis, qualified prosecution response and corrected count reference retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged drafts/advice excluded from CPS/court; served basis controlled for child identity.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated charge text, generic plea guidance, unsigned basis shown as agreed or artificial issue rows.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Protected prosecution Newton evidence: Y1 account register/extracts, W1 signed statement, contextual records/exhibits and disputed chronology.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; statements/transcripts 300-550 words/page, chronology 10-22 events/page and few necessary exhibits.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans, protected native recording referenced by hash, searchable extracts and born-digital chronology.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Child language, uncertain dates, inaudible passage and W1 frequency uncertainty retained without smoothing.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Strict child identity/content and witness-contact controls; client receives only authorised preparation material.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No full repeated interview, decorative stills, reconstructed words, duplicated chronology or advocacy inserted into evidence.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Defence Newton evidence: D1 statement, contextual records and signed witnesses with a challenged chronology and source schedule.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-24 pages; statements 250-450 words/page, records at authentic density and chronologies 10-22 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed statements and authentic record extracts; born-digital schedule links originals without reproduction.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Changing recollection, incomplete record period and corrected event date allowed with explicit history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence drafts/advice privileged; only authorised served evidence reaches prosecution/court; third-party data minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No character-reference bulk, repeated D1 account, invented corroboration, duplicate records or unsigned material presented as served.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Newton issue/directions order, hearing transcript or proportionate extracts, exhibit list, party submissions, issue-specific factual ruling and reasons.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-34 pages; transcript 350-600 words/page, submissions/ruling 250-500 words/page and issue tables 5-14 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital transcript/submissions and signed/sealed directions/ruling; audio source referenced if any.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Reserved decision, corrected transcript and perfected ruling after oral reasons retained without silent replacement.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Child reporting/privacy restrictions persist; privileged preparation excluded; public and controlled versions separated.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No fabricated testimony/reasons, duplicated transcript, copied legal tests or unresolved issue shown as found.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Pre-sentence report, source and verification schedule, risk/needs assessment, recommendation, addendum and party dangerousness submissions.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-26 pages; PSR 300-500 words/page, assessment tables 6-16 domains/page and concise sourced addendum.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital controlled report with signed declaration and structured tables; source records referenced, not embedded wholesale.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unverified self-report, unavailable collateral source and later addendum allowed with transparent status.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: PSR and safeguarding content restricted to proper recipients; client copy removes third-party contact detail, not material conclusions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated offence narrative, unsupported actuarial score, generic recommendations, bulk source records or statutory finding language.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Victim personal statement, focused child clinical extracts, paediatric report/addendum and source/limitations schedule; separates impact, observation and opinion.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-20 pages; VPS/clinical/report pages at authentic density, tabular clinical chronology 8-18 events/page and images only if essential.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed/scanned VPS and certified clinical extracts; born-digital expert report; any medical image separately restricted and hashed.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Clinical abbreviation, amended entry and narrowed expert opinion retained with audit trail.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Maximum child-health and image controls; unnecessary diagnoses/contact detail excluded; use follows ruling.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No unrelated medical history, repeated observations, decorative images, generic paediatrics or impact treated as conduct proof.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Certified antecedents, identity reconciliation, references, employment/caring records and current financial-means evidence.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-24 pages; official records/forms at authentic density, references 250-400 words/page and financial tables 8-20 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed certified records, signed letters and native/born-digital means schedule with narrowly selected supporting scans.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Same-name mismatch, dated reference, changed employment and stale means entry allowed when flagged.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Financial identifiers and third-party details minimised; references and records distributed only for sentence.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicated antecedents, mass references, full bank statements, unverified praise or stale figure silently treated as current.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Current guideline/source index, prosecution and defence sentencing submissions, hearing record, remarks, ancillary-order applications/decisions, perfected order and appeal/deadline record.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-27 pages; submissions/remarks 300-500 words/page, orders/forms authentic and source/index tables 8-18 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital submissions/index and signed/sealed court records; public links preserved; drafts visibly non-operative.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Updated guideline check, oral clarification and perfected-order correction retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged advice restricted; child identifiers controlled in open remarks/order; filed materials role-available.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied guideline text, invented judicial remarks, duplicate orders, speculative appeal advice or artificial factors.
